fact: 244 young Togolese received certificates on 29 April 2025 after five months of D-CLIC digital training in Lomé, Aného, Kara and Dapaong, with the digital economy ministry present.
title: Francophonie : Togo, 244 jeunes et femmes formés avec D-CLIC
publisher: Délégation permanente du Togo auprès de l'UNESCO
